host.description: Server host name (FQDN): web client host, SMTP banner and Carbonio server name. It cannot change after the first configuration.

lets_encrypt.description: Request a Let's Encrypt certificate for the host name, also used by SMTP, IMAP and POP3

cluster_role.description: standalone (default): one complete server. master: a complete server that other servers can join. worker: an additional mailbox server that joins a master.

join.description: Module id of the master to join (worker role)

accept_join.description: A master accepts new servers (default true)

mail_domain.description: First mail domain, created with the administrator account (standalone and master, first configuration only)

admin_user.description: Local part of the administrator account, first configuration only (default admin)

admin_password.description: Password of the administrator account: required by the first configuration of a standalone or master server, then optional to change it. Never returned.

admin_host.description: Optional host name (FQDN) that Traefik routes to the Carbonio Admin Panel; empty: no route

antivirus.description: ClamAV antivirus scan of the mail (default true). It needs about 1.3 GiB of RAM.

mailbox_heap_mb.description: Java heap of the mailbox service, in MiB (default 1536)

timezone.description: Default time zone of new accounts (default: the node time zone)

features.description: Optional suites, reserved for a later release: they must be false
